notes: Right-to-left machines: a nested bar loads with part 1 at the leading end of the bar, a bar opened from the portal is turned for the feed direction, and on a live cell an unregistered bar rests on the infeed side. The conveyor jog panel follows the feed direction (Outfeed | Together | Infeed, arrows point the way the bar moves) - every button drives the same signal as before. Angle wrist rotation is set by side of the cell: Leg 1 (robot side) and Leg 2 (far side), whichever leg of the part lands there. Cuts, holes, marks, scans, MEBP finds and highway corners all follow the same toggle, the same in both feed directions, and MEBP no longer takes a rotation of its own. New Speed correction table: a percentage of chart speed per chart row, beside Angle and Gap; cuts and their leads follow it. Also: angle cuts no longer shift in Y when the legs are ripped down, holes no longer stay lit after ARCFIRE2, and the Y=H datum seats ripped nest parts on the stock.
